intent: Monochrome floating glass pill nav for dark sites: unfolds on first view, sliding hover pill, tucks in on scroll, full-screen mobile sheet with focus trap.

stack.animation: motion/react (useScroll, useMotionValueEvent, useInView, LayoutGroup, AnimatePresence, variants with custom delays)

layout.bar: max-w 1200px → 720px condensed; logo left, links centre (md+), CTA right
layout.sheet: fixed inset-0, pt-28, links → CTA → contact → socials

color.approach: monochrome: black, white and greys only; tokens in one COLOR/SHADOW object
color.cta: white with black text, hover #ececee, no glow

motion.entrance: pill: opacity 300ms, y -10 → 0 500ms, max-width 640 → 1200 tween 650ms; logo at 100ms, links from 160ms 50ms apart, action cluster at 420ms; each block opacity + y 8px + blur 6px → 0 over 450ms
motion.condense: max-width + padding on spring.ui after 80px; wordmark width → 0 + fade
motion.sheet: clipPath inset(0 0 100% 0) → inset(0) 600ms; links rise from masks 60ms apart from 180ms; CTA, contact columns, socials rise from blur 60ms apart from 420ms
motion.demo: changelog blocks stagger 70ms after the bar; entries reveal once at 25% visibility, waiting for the page intro when already on screen
motion.reducedMotion: 150ms fades only; no unfold, no springs, sheet fades
motion.press: links and buttons 0.96; CTA arrow nudges 3px; menu label rolls 260ms

responsive.mobile: Menu pill + sheet; links and CTA hidden
responsive.md+: inline links and CTA; sheet auto-closes

content.demoPage: Changelog: 'Small releases, every week.' + v4.12–v4.9 entries

avoid: coloured glow fields or a hue per card
glow behind the CTA or logo
filter/transform on an ancestor of the fixed sheet
a fake landing page behind the bar
